specification.objective: Condense the Stored memory header statistics into one readable responsive summary band so more room remains for reviewing memory entries.

requirements.statement: At ordinary Desktop widths, Entries, Characters, Estimated tokens and character-budget progress occupy a single compact row in one summary band; small screens reflow without horizontal clipping.
Keep the active target, used/available character counts, approximate token usage/budget, usage percent and remaining free characters visible with correct labels.
Preserve existing theme tokens, native usage bar, memory APIs, editable content and action buttons, without new dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A focused regression detects when the Stored memory summary is no longer a compact responsive band containing three data items and a budget progress segment.
A focused regression checks retention of the four metric names, value expressions, active target and remaining-budget feedback.
Existing Desktop tests, Hermes validation and POLIS strict coverage gates pass.

invariants.statement: Stored-memory values remain bound to targetData for the selected target without backend changes.
The shared StatCard remains available to existing other views.
The summary uses existing Hermes theme CSS variables and React JSX primitives.

forbidden_states.statement: A Desktop-width summary displays four full-width cards in two rows.
A compact summary omits token approximations or the free-character indicator.
The change mutates stored memory or alters the API contract.

inputs.statement: Magi 1.7.7 StoredMemoryPage and the user-supplied screenshot showing two rows of large metric cards.

outputs.statement: A reduced-height responsive metric summary in desktop/plugin.js.
Focused Red-to-Green test and POLIS artifact validation.

failure_semantics.statement: Missing values retain existing zero defaults, and remaining budget is bounded to zero.
Invalid responsive summary regressions or strict gates block the release artifact.
